messages:
Cassie: Quick heads-up — I'm shifting my handoff 30m earlier tomorrow so there's a 20:00-20:30 overlap. Can we confirm escalation coverage + waitlist? Also dropping the open incidents I think we should cover in the 20:00 triage.

Cassie: Open incidents to triage:
- INC-4124: inference SLO breaches in us-west1 (partial degradation). Assigned: Devon (investigating).
- INC-4131: dedicated pool OOMs on model-x (intermittent). No owner yet.
- INC-4133: canary alert flapping post-deploy on canary-2.

Devon: I can keep owning INC-4124 through the overlap — will paste findings + tail logs before handoff. ETA ~25m.

Pranav: I can pick up INC-4131 tonight if nobody objects. Need node/GPU list + SSH access (will ping infra).

Liam: I'll be on the escalation waitlist and can jump on INC-4133 if it spikes. I can also host the 20:00 triage call (bridge + agenda).

OncallBot: [automated] Reminder: triage call in #incident-bridge at 20:00 UTC. Current oncall transition: Cassie -> Devon (overlap 20:00-20:30).

Cassie: Proposed 20:00 triage agenda:
1) Quick roundtable (5m)
2) INC-4124: current state + next steps (10m)
3) INC-4131: assignment + access checklist (5m)
4) INC-4133: canary rollback / flags (5m)
5) Action items + owners (5m)
Please ping if you want to add anything.

Devon: I'll post a short log snippet pre-handoff: ```journalctl -u inference.service -n 200 | grep -E 'OOM|error|failed'```

Pranav: Grant request opened with infra (cc @Olga). If SSH delayed I can still triage via kube: `kubectl describe pod -n inference model-x-*` and `kubectl logs -f <pod>`

Olga: Grant approved — Pranav should have the node/GPU access in ~10m.

Liam: small ops note — if INC-4131 needs headroom we can enable the burst pool toggle from the console: `--enable-burst` (costy, use as last resort).

Cassie: Ok — please react with :thumbsup: if you can keep the 20:00-20:30 overlap tomorrow, :thumbsdown: if not. I'll post a final handoff bullet list in this thread at EOD.

Devon: :thumbsup:

Pranav: :thumbsup:

Liam: :thumbsup:

Olga: :thumbsup:

Cassie: Thanks all — will confirm bridge link + agenda in #incident-bridge 30m before triage.

Cassie: (post-shift plan) I'll leave a short handoff note here with links to logs, PRs to watch, and next steps so the oncoming shift has everything in one place.
